proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.kind = "item" | "object" on activation phases
proposed_widenings.justification: Tree Form targets the staff itself, not the wielder, a creature, or an area.
proposed_widenings.evidence: plant one end of the staff in earth in an unoccupied space and expend 1 charge to transform the staff into a healthy tree

proposed_widenings.name: EffectAtom.kind = "fall_on_end" (or equivalent end-of-form fallout rider)
proposed_widenings.justification: Reverting the transformed staff has a deterministic mechanical consequence for creatures occupying it. v4 already has this concept, but the surface does not.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Any creature in the tree falls when the tree reverts to a staff

proposed_widenings.name: ItemDestructionPolicy nondestructive last-charge shutdown
proposed_widenings.justification: The last-charge rider removes the item's magic without destroying the underlying quarterstaff, which current destruction policies cannot represent honestly.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the staff loses its properties and becomes a nonmagical Quarterstaff

notes: Authored a composite subset for the held-item bonuses, spell list, charge pool, dawn recharge, and druid-only attunement. Omitted Tree Form and the special last-charge shutdown rider because encoding them would require surface widening.
